layouts.name: Fort Devens
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Western runway to intersection, Eastern runway, Northern taxiway loop branches, Middle taxiway connection, Northern training connection, Northern diagonal training strip, Northern vertical training strip, Eastern training connection, Northern short return. sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The catalogue footprint represents open airfield branches used at the Devens autocross venue. The independently mapped Western runway stops at its junction with the Eastern runway; the Eastern runway, Northern taxiway loop, middle connection and Northern training branches retain their mapped open ends. The organizer identifies the disused runways as the autocross site. This is the physical branch network, not a fixed cone-defined race lap. Historical limits and temporary event course alignment remain draft. The unlisted East-West runway, Southeastern runway extension and unrelated Northern access spur are excluded. The independent unique branch distance is 3582.9 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
